decisions.rationale: Accepted as a low, wording-only inaccuracy in maintainer and evidence text, recorded as a known wording inaccuracy without a further correction loop; not escalated, because it is not a concrete high or medium defect in accepted behaviour. I reproduced every part on a fresh git archive of 598e61a2 with the private completed work plus one appended probe rule, full public suite, 2 runs each, unmodified completed work passing all 12 in 2 of 2. (a) The held value after finish() is the value at the end of the final iteration, which depends on direction and iteration count, not on which keyframe is written last: a short reverse forwards-filled reduced-scale animation whose last keyframe is identity failed task 11 only in 2 of 2, a two-iteration alternate forwards-filled one failed task 11 only in 2 of 2, and a very long linear reverse forwards-filled animation whose last keyframe is the reduced scale passed all 12 in 2 of 2, each the opposite of what 'its last keyframe if it fills forwards' predicts. (b) The finish step in tests/layout.test.mjs (lines 140-144) runs only when getComputedTiming().endTime is a finite number; in the pinned Chromium a scroll(root) animation on a tag reports endTime as the string 100% and Number.isFinite false, so it is never finished and is read at the current scroll position, and a scroll-driven padding growth on both tags filled both ways passed all 12 in 2 of 2 while a direct page probe at 1280x1000 showed the required padding at the top and a larger padding after scrolling to the bottom; so 'the finite animations' is imprecise without 'time-based'. (c) A very long linear forwards-filled animation from a reduced scale to identity on both tags passed all 12 in 2 of 2, so the owner-accepted cl5 identity-end case is real and the qualifier 'that does not hold its effect after it ends' leaves it out of the first example; the examples are introduced as non-exhaustive, so this part is a note. Severity stays low: every probe outcome is covered by the general sentence that any animation changing the drawn size at some other moment can go undetected, README task 11 Outcome forbids all of these animations for learners, test bytes are unchanged, and every case falls inside the owner's option A one-instant residual (very long, reversed and scroll-position-dependent animations are read at one instant); no detection change, seek, sampling or keyframe classifier is asked for or warranted. Smallest correct fix, if a later authorized pass touches this text: in lab.json cleanup.notes and the next solved-run record's not-covered list only, say 'finite time-based animations', replace 'its last keyframe' with 'its end value', add 'including scroll-driven ones' to the clause about every other animation, and drop the qualifier 'that does not hold its effect after it ends' from the first example; this stays inside the approved minimal loop-6 scope and the option A residual wording and does not expand the contract, but under the terminal loop-9 declaration it is recorded, not applied.
